reviewer: native Codex subagent handoff_scientific_scope; computational review, not independent human peer review
method: Read exact manuscript, source and archived wrapper; derive moment and score bounds; evaluate analytic constants only.

findings.detail: Temporal r=.7 example is correct; spatial LI+ ratio moment and S02 M2 ratio moment diverge in their ideal fresh exponential laws. Separate first-parent/Jensen proof establishes null divergence under bounded-kernel/fresh-mark hypotheses.
M2 sets r=0 but keeps exp(gamma*(Q-1)); h>0 is parent-class persistent and outside the fresh-mark theorem. Generator/candidate kernel mismatch remains.
Total null bracket is E integral G?(B+nH), not immigrant ratio bracket. Same-parent E[g?*kappa] is a necessary obstruction, not a complete sufficiency criterion; at spatial parameters it diverges.
Positive eta has finite bracket bounds in both attenuation families under the stated envelope. Ideal unstopped law differs from finite machine grids, capped execution and completed histories.
Null moment irregularity does not prove a causal explanation of held-out losses, fitted parameter selection or optimizer behavior.

Large-mark one-event histories remain positive-support for every finite q, but survival decays at least exp(-a*kappa(q)); no useful-history frequency or finite-sample guarantee follows. M2 kappa=1 and bounded marks are outside this proof.

limits: No new empirical mechanism or predictive claim established.
No claim that total null terminal variance equals infinite expected bracket without further martingale integrability.
No generic sufficient mixed-moment theorem for total attenuation.
No fresh-mark theorem transferred to persistent h>0 law.
Conductor mathematical review and manuscript integration remain separate.
